app.name: Vault
app.description: Internal ops registry for ByteForce and B-Systems.

search.label: Search Vault
search.noResultsHint: Search covers names, notes and descriptions — not what is inside a file.
search.resultCount: {count, plural, =0 {No results} one {1 result} other {# results}}

common.archiveConfirmBody: This moves it to the archive. It disappears from views and counts, and an admin can restore it — nothing is ever permanently deleted.
common.notFoundBody: Check the address, or head back to Forms.

forms.title: Forms
forms.subtitle: Every form link both companies use, in one place.
forms.urlHint: The full address, starting with http:// or https://

empty.title: No forms yet
empty.body: Vault holds the link to every form either company runs, so nobody has to dig through a chat thread to find one again.
empty.employeeNote: An admin adds forms. They will appear here.

sheets.title: Sheets
sheets.subtitle: Linked and uploaded spreadsheets, with how much is in them.
sheets.modeLink: A link to a live sheet
sheets.modeHint: One or the other — a sheet cannot be both, and cannot be neither.
sheets.fileHint: XLSX, XLS or CSV, up to 25 MB. The record count is read from the file.
sheets.recordCountHint: A count means nothing without its date, so both are needed.
sheets.headerExcluded: the first row read as a header and was not counted
sheets.xlsNotCounted: Legacy .xls files are stored but not counted — enter the number by hand.
sheets.dateCreatedHint: When the sheet itself was made, not when it was added here.

empty.title: No sheets yet
empty.body: Link a live spreadsheet or upload one. Uploaded files get their record count read for you, so the number never goes stale unnoticed.
empty.employeeNote: An admin adds sheets. They will appear here.

documents.title: Documents
documents.subtitle: Contracts, proposals and everything filed alongside them.
documents.fileHint: PDF, Word or Excel, up to 25 MB.
documents.previewUnavailable: Only PDFs preview in the browser. Download this one to open it.

empty.title: No documents yet
empty.body: Upload a contract, proposal or report and it becomes findable by name, type and company — instead of living in somebody's downloads folder.
empty.employeeNote: An admin adds documents. They will appear here.

tasks.title: Tasks
tasks.subtitle: {people, plural, one {One person} other {# people}}, {open} open, {overdue} overdue.
tasks.subtitleEmployee: {open, plural, =0 {Nothing open} one {Your one open task} other {Your # open tasks}}, soonest first.
tasks.lateByDays: Late by {days, plural, one {1 day} other {# days}}
tasks.name: Task name
tasks.reopenConfirmBody: The completion date and the recorded lateness are cleared. The result text and any files stay. This is written to the activity log with the previous values.
tasks.noTasksAdmin: No tasks for this person yet.

empty.title: No employees yet
empty.body: Tasks are organised by person. Add an employee, and their card appears here with their own task table.

emptyEmployee.title: Nothing assigned to you
emptyEmployee.body: When an admin assigns you a task it appears here, with the nearest deadline first.

result.title: Add result
result.anyOneIsEnough: Text, a file or a link — any one of them is enough to complete the task.
result.dropFiles: Drop files here, or choose them. 25 MB each.
result.footnote: Saving stores the result and completes the task. Only an admin can reopen it afterwards.
result.footnoteShort: Only an admin can reopen a completed task.
result.lateWarning: Saving now records this task as late by {days, plural, one {1 day} other {# days}}.
result.needSomething: Add a note, a file or a link first.

archive.title: Archive
archive.subtitle: Everything that was deleted. Nothing here is gone — restore any of it.

empty.title: The archive is empty
empty.body: Deleting a record moves it here instead of destroying it. Nothing has been deleted yet.

overdue.title: Overdue
overdue.subtitle: Every open task past its deadline, across everyone.

empty.title: Nothing is overdue
empty.body: Every open task is still within its deadline.

auth.signInHint: Use the email address your admin registered.
auth.invalidCredentials: That email and password do not match. Check both and try again.
auth.noSignup: Vault has no public sign-up. An admin creates your account and emails you an invitation link.
auth.activateHint: Welcome, {name}. Choose a password and you are in.
auth.resetHint: Set a new password for your account.
auth.passwordHint: At least 10 characters. Nobody at ByteForce can see it, including admins.
auth.linkDeadHint: Ask your admin to send a new invitation.

linkDead.unknown: We do not recognise this link. It may have been mistyped or already replaced.
linkDead.used: This link has already been used. If that was you, sign in with the password you set.
linkDead.revoked: A newer invitation was sent, which replaced this one. Use the most recent email.
linkDead.expired: This link expired. Invitations are valid for 7 days.

employees.title: Employees
employees.subtitle: Who has access, and who has a task card.
employees.createdNoMail: {name} added, but the invitation email could not be sent. Use “Resend invitation”.
employees.deactivated: {name} deactivated. Their task history is kept.
employees.invitationFailed: The email could not be sent. Check the mail server.
employees.deactivateConfirmBody: They will be signed out and their card hidden. Every task they completed, including the late records, is kept. You can reactivate them later — nothing is deleted.

empty.title: No employees yet
empty.body: Add the people who will use Vault. Each one gets an invitation link and their own task card.

emptyInactive.title: Nobody is deactivated
emptyInactive.body: Deactivated employees appear here, with their history intact.
